series.label: Palestine refugees registered with UNRWA in Lebanon (reported figures)
series.notes: Reported figures from UNRWA publications as quoted in: UNRWA Lebanon page archive 2008 (2006: 409,714, as of 31 Dec 2006); PCBS/CAS 2017 census press release (2016: 459,292); UNRWA in Figures 2018 (469,555). Registered refugees include people who emigrated; many no longer live in Lebanon, so this overstates residents. Licence not checked per source.

series.label: Palestine refugees under UNRWA mandate, Lebanon field, 31 Dec 2025
series.notes: UNRWA dataset "Palestine Refugees: field and demographics, 2025 Q4" (HDX, CC BY-IGO). 115,296 female, 112,978 male. This is far below the 469,555 registered in 2018; the definition used in the dataset has not been verified, so do not chart it against older registered figures.

series.label: Palestine refugees from Lebanon counted in the 2017 camps and gatherings census
series.notes: CAS and Palestinian Central Bureau of Statistics, Population and Housing Census in the Palestinian Camps and Gatherings 2017: 74,687 PRL in 12 camps plus 90,862 in gatherings. Total individuals counted 224,901 incl. Palestine refugees from Syria and other nationalities. Counts people actually enumerated, a lower figure than UNRWA registration.

series.label: Migrant domestic worker permits (new plus renewed), Ministry of Labour (reported)
series.notes: Reported figures from secondary sources, not the Ministry primary tables: 2010 and 2012 from ODI (Mansour-Ille, cdn.odi.org/media/documents/11547.pdf, 2010: 80,209 renewals + 37,732 new, citing MoL); 2018 and 2020 from ILO Regional Brief on domestic work in the Arab States (based on unpublished MoL data). Only documented workers.

series.label: Migrant domestic workers in Lebanon, estimates (reported)
series.notes: Reported estimates: 255,813 = work-permit total used to weight the ILO 2016 MDW survey (ILO / CRI Analytical Report, wcms_524143); ILO 2017 recruitment study says "over 250,000". Civil society estimates up to 85,000 may be undocumented (ODI). Use as order of magnitude.

series.label: Lebanese leaving the country per year (Information International, reported)
series.notes: Reported, not official: the Beirut firm Information International computes departures from General Security arrival and departure statistics. 2018 and 2021: UNDP Remittances in Lebanon report (June 2023) citing Information International (2022), 215,653 for 2018-2021. 2012 (about 49,000), 2023 and 2024: statement by Information International researcher quoted in Nidaa al-Watan, Nov 2025 (dailylebanon.net/?p=158694); 798,911 total for 2012-2024. Definition (gross or net, Lebanese only) not confirmed. No official emigration series exists.
